input.quote: 7.6 Vendor warrants that Fees charged to Customer will be no less favourable than fees offered to any similarly situated customer for comparable volumes and terms.
input.rationale: The only MFN-type language in the Agreement is § 7.6, which runs in our favour: Brightline warrants that Fees charged to us will be no less favourable than fees offered to similarly situated customers for comparable volumes and terms. Searches for "most favoured", "no less favourable", "favourable/favorable", "best terms", and exclusivity/preferred-provider language turned up nothing imposing any MFN, price-matching, or best-terms obligation on Northwind, and the fees, order-form and general sections (§§ 4, 7, 30) contain no such covenant. This matches the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer; Vendor-granted MFN pricing is welcome), so we keep § 7.6 as drafted and propose no redline.
